newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 90,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs estimate Friday 90,000 - USDA.

text.p: Estimated interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog receipts Friday were 90,000 head, compared with 89,000 a week ago and 84,000 a year ago.
Saturday's estimate was 15,000 head, compared with 14,000 a week ago and 13,000 a year ago. Estimates include generally about 65 percent Carcass Base Hogs.
Barrows and gilts were steady to $0.50 per cwt higher than at midsession Thursday. Trade was slow for moderate to good demand and light offerings.

Compared to last week: Barrows and Gilts $1.00-$1.50 higher. Sows $0.50-$2.00 higher. Receipts this week 515,000 head, last week 499,000, last year 465,000. Barrows and Gilts average weight for week ending June 21, 1997 was 253.0 lbs compared to 254.3 lbs previous week 248.2 lbs last year.
